# Public-domain face tracking fixture

`nasa-astronaut-face.png` is a cropped/resized NASA photograph of astronaut
Eileen Collins, distributed as the public-domain astronaut test image by
scikit-image. Source: https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.25.2/skimage/data/astronaut.png

The fixture tests face detection and moving camera crops, not identity recognition.
No user video frames are included.
